bugs.title: run_full_pipeline has no project_dir_override parameter
bugs.evidence: TypeError: run_full_pipeline() got an unexpected keyword argument 'project_dir_override'
bugs.expected: An override parameter so callers (tests, integrations) can specify a fixed project_dir
bugs.root_cause: API surface omitted a project_dir_override kwarg; callers had to mutate config.project_dir to control the output path, which is fragile across the singleton Config.
bugs.fix: Added project_dir_override: Optional[str] = None parameter to run_full_pipeline. When provided, uses it directly; otherwise computes from config.project_dir + slugified concept.
bugs.verification: test_inventory_pipeline.test_cached_resume_skips_completed_phases passes; new test_BUG001_ProjectDirOverride in test_regression_qa_fixes.py passes

bugs.title: run_characters crashes on factions as list[str]
bugs.evidence: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get' at line 73
bugs.expected: Defensive handling of both dict and string faction formats
bugs.root_cause: LLM-generated factions may be either dict (with .get('name')) or bare strings depending on model. Code assumed dict-only.
bugs.fix: Added isinstance(f, dict) / isinstance(f, str) / fallback str() handling for faction name extraction in characters.py.
bugs.verification: test_BUG002_FactionsDefensive.test_string_factions passes; both test_string_factions and test_dict_factions in regression suite

bugs.title: run_draft raises ValueError on empty outline
bugs.repro: outline = {"acts": []}; run_draft(spec, world, chars, outline, project_dir, config)
bugs.evidence: ValueError: No chapters found in outline
bugs.expected: Graceful skip with WARNING print and empty chapters list
bugs.root_cause: Treating empty outline as an error rather than a valid (though unusual) input. Users with intentional single-act or experimental outlines were unable to proceed past phase 5.
bugs.fix: Replaced raise with print(WARNING) and return [] so pipeline continues.

bugs.title: Mock response for outline returns seed-shaped data
bugs.repro: route_response() picks _seed_response for outline calls because OUTLINE_USER_TEMPLATE contains 'Premise:' which matches the seed heuristic ('concept' and 'premise' in combined)
bugs.evidence: Test failure: outline has no 'acts' key
bugs.expected: Routing picks outline response for outline requests
bugs.root_cause: Routing heuristics evaluated 'outline' after 'seed' — but the outline prompt also contains 'Premise:', so seed heuristic matched first.
bugs.fix: Moved outline routing rule above seed routing rule in mock_api._route_response.

bugs.title: EmbeddingStore hardcodes a specific embedding model and assumes it is installed
bugs.repro: import EmbeddingStore; store.search('anything') — without sentence_transformers installed
bugs.expected: Graceful degradation: search returns [] when model unavailable
bugs.root_cause: The store reached for sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 directly, violating the project's model-agnostic principle. It also failed with ModuleNotFoundError on a fresh install because sentence-transformers is not in pyproject.toml dependencies.
bugs.fix: Made EmbeddingStore model-agnostic via Config.embeddings (EmbeddingConfig): mode='none' (default, no-op) | 'local' (sentence-transformers, model name from Config.embeddings.local_model) | 'remote' (LLM API through Config.embeddings.remote_model_alias, default 'flash'). When disabled, search() returns [] and add() stores content with NULL embedding. Hardcoded model name removed; users opt in via LLM_ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS=1.
bugs.verification: test_BUG005_EmbeddingStoreGraceful still passes. New: default mode is 'none' and add()/search() work without sentence-transformers installed. Pipeline can run end-to-end on a fresh install with no embedding deps.

bugs.title: pyproject.toml missing embedding dependencies, but they are no longer required
bugs.evidence: ModuleNotFoundError on first chapter due to EmbeddingStore importing sentence_transformers
bugs.expected: Dependencies declared so a fresh install produces a working pipeline
bugs.root_cause: Original concern: embedding_store required sentence-transformers + torch but they were not in pyproject.toml. The project is model-agnostic and should not pin a specific embedding backend by default.
bugs.fix: Embeddings are now opt-in (LLM_ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS=1). Default mode='none' means a fresh install needs zero embedding dependencies. Users who want local mode install sentence-transformers themselves; users who want remote mode use the LLM API. The principle of model-agnosticism is preserved: the user picks the model, the project never hardcodes one.
bugs.verification: fresh-install test: with no embedding deps, run_full_pipeline completes the full draft phase. EmbeddingStore degrades to NULL embeddings, search() returns [], no ModuleNotFoundError.

bugs.title: pipeline/outline.py crashed on string factions
bugs.root_cause: Same fragility as BUG-002 — outline.py assumed factions are always dicts.
bugs.fix: Replaced dict-only access with dict/string/fallback handling.
bugs.verification: test_BUG007_OutlineFactionsDefensive passes; full pipeline test now passes

bugs.title: build_manuscript_markdown crashed on dict geography
bugs.evidence: KeyError: slice(None, 500, None) — dict cannot be sliced with [:500]
bugs.expected: Defensive coercion to string for string/dict/list geography formats
bugs.root_cause: Same LLM-output fragility — geography can be string, dict, or list depending on the model and prompt response.
bugs.fix: Added type-coercion branch: dict → 'k: v, k: v', list → ', '.join, default → str(geo).

bugs.title: build_manuscript_markdown crashed on character dict without 'personality'
bugs.evidence: KeyError or empty output depending on dict.get defaults
bugs.expected: Fall back to other character fields (arc, background) when personality is missing
bugs.root_cause: Character dicts from LLM may omit optional fields like 'personality'.
bugs.fix: personality = c.get('personality') or c.get('arc') or c.get('background') or ''

bugs.title: Test pipeline calls run with feedback_enabled=True by default, blocking on stdin

bugs.expected: Inventory tests should always pass feedback_enabled=False
bugs.root_cause: Test calls used default feedback_enabled=True. The pipeline post-chapter feedback loop blocks waiting for terminal input.
bugs.fix: Added explicit feedback_enabled=False kwarg to all run_full_pipeline calls in test_inventory_pipeline.py.
bugs.verification: test_full_pipeline_minimal and test_cached_resume_skips_completed_phases now complete without hanging
